batting.dismissal: c Arshad Khan b Mohammed Siraj

batting.dismissal: c JO Holder b K Rabada

batting.name: TU Deshpande
batting.dismissal: c Washington Sundar b JO Holder

balls.text: full toss on the stumps and Sundar cannot quite get this away. Looks for the fall-away scoop but ends up shanking it behind square. GT finish on 229!

Deshpande responds with the perfect yorker, and this whooshes Sundar off his feet. A touch outside leg and Sundar is rushed on the sweep. Ends up on the deck and from almost a prone position, he reviews the wide. Not sure why he has reviewed that because Sundar got nutmegged. Strange review...
this is a shot and a half! Back of a length outside off. Sits up a little and Sundar, standing tall, crunches it off the back foot over long off. Wow!
back of a length outside off. Tewatia reaches out for it and slaps it towards sweeper cover
innovation at its best! Back of a length delivery wide outside off. Tewaita shuffles across and swipes it over short fine leg!
Tewatia lands his first blow! Juicy full toss on the pads, and Tewatia feasts. He clears his front leg and wallops it flat over deep square leg!
nails the length on the yorker but this too is down leg. Tewatia makes no contact and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
top bowling by Brijesh. Slower ball on a length outside off. Sundar tries to smash it into next week and loses all shape. Makes no contact in the end
very full outside off and that denies Sundar the room he wants. Shanks it back to the bowler
full toss outside off. Sundar looks to help it behind point but seems to get beaten for pace
slower ball bowled into the track outside off. Sundar throws his hands at it and chips it over extra cover for a couple of runs
length ball hung up wide outside off. Tewatia reaches out for it and chalks it towards extra cover. Hares across for the run and is helped by Jaiswal missing his shy

Shanked to extra cover, and the slower ball does the trick for Brijesh! Dug in outside off too, meaning Holder has to reach out for it and then try to fetch it. He tries his best but he is always working against the line. A tame slice in the end and Jaiswal, stood at extra cover, makes no mistake!
Low full toss speared in a mile down leg. Holder can get nowhere near it but fortunately for RR, Jurel can. Just a solitary wide
low full toss on middle and off. Holder opens up his stance and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket
banged in short outside off and this skids through. Holder tried to step down but was hurried into his swipe. Excellent bowling!
another brilliant yorker on middle and off. Holder's turn to jam down on it and he can only keep it out
excellent yorker on leg stump. Sundar gets his bat down in time and squeezes it out towards deep square leg
speared in full but also down leg. Sundar does not make contact and the umpire signals for a wide
into the blockhole just outside off. Holder jams down on it and clinks it out into the off side
Holder wants a piece of the action now! Full, wide and there to be hit. Holder uses his long levers and bangs it over extra cover!

Sundar goes big now. Not by much, though! Slower ball in the slot on the pads. Sundar opens up his front hip and heaves it towards deep square leg. Shanaka circles under it and gets a hand to it but can only push it beyond the fence!
pinged into the gap! Shortish just outside off and Sundar has the time to pick his spot. He waits on it and muscles it between deep mid wicket and long on!
slower ball on a length well outside leg. Sundar looks to play the sweep over short fine but is too early into it. Off the toe-end and into his body
fullish just outside off. Holder presses half forward and pushes it to long off

Gill looks for something funky, and Gill departs! Speared in full outside off. Gill is perhaps anticipating that delivery too and he shapes up for the scoop. Gets into a tangle where he cannot free his arms enough, though, and the ball clinks off the toe-end. Deshpande takes it neatly over his shoulder while back-pedaling from short fine, and Gill's excellent knock has come to an end!
glorious! Full enough outside off and that is all Gill needs. He sets up a solid base, goes through the line and carves it over extra cover!
low full toss on middle and off. Gill cannot get under this either and squeezes it out to deep mid wicket
nails the yorker again, zoning into middle and off. Sundar clinks it out into the off side
right up in the blockhole on off. Gill cannot do much with it and digs it out towards long on
full just outside off. Gill plants his front foot and powers it on the bounce to long on. Back for a brace
shortish on middle and leg. Sundar hops up onto his toes and helps it towards deep mid wicket
uff, this is some shot! Another slower ball and this lands right in the slot on off. Sundar lets his hands flow through the line and creams it over mid off!
begins with a slower ball but gets the radar wrong again. Sprays this down leg on a length and the umpire calls it a wide once Sundar misses his scoop
low full toss, speared in well outside off. Sundar reaches out for it and scuffs it towards long off
darted in on a length outside off. Gill opens up his stance and drags it towards deep mid wicket
right in the gap! Misses the yorker this time on leg stump, and Gill is all over it. He snaps his wrists into action and shovels it between long on and deep mid wicket!
fired into the blockhole on off. Gill chalks it back to the bowler
quicker and shorter outside off. Sundar punches it towards long off
up and over! Flighted up into the slot outside off. Sundar gets his hands through the ball nicely and caresses it over extra cover!
on a length outside off. Gill throws his hands at it and powers it towards deep extra cover, where Shanaka lunges to his left and keeps it to two
back of a length on middle and leg. Sundar eases it out to deep mid wicket
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Sundar clinks it out towards the bowler
given a bit of air on a full length on off. Sundar works it to deep mid wicket, who misfields and allows Sundar to get off the mark with a brace

another miscue and this time, taken! Jadeja does that pocket celebration, and this is a huge wicket! Tossed up a touch outside off and Buttler's eyes light up. He looks to go downtown but slices across it way too much. Ferreira comes in off the long off fence and does the rest. Buttler disappointed with himself, but this is another very handy breakthrough!
length outside off. Buttler tries his hand at the reverse but misses it this time
top shot! Back of a length on middle and leg. Gill unleashes the reverse and nails it over short third!
short and wide outside off. Gill lets it go and the umpire, perhaps harshly, calls it a wide. No wide review, though

miscued, and it lands into safety! Punja pulls the length back outside off, after seeing the batter advance. Gill looks to go inside-out and slices it. The ball loops over extra cover and falls in front of Hetmyer, rushing in from sweeper cover
back of a length on leg. Buttler misses his flick and the ball rolls into the on side. Gill is okay to take the single and Buttler has to hurry to get there
leg-spinner on a length on middle and off. Buttler comes forward and defends with an open bat face
clean as a whistle! Flighted up into the slot outside off. Buttler spots the googly, plants his front foot and launches it over long on!
tossed up on a length on middle and leg. Buttler gets squared up and plonks it off the leading edge towards backward point
length outside off. Buttler stays on top of the bounce and punches it towards sweeper cover
length ball hung up wide outside off. Gill reaches out for it and slaps it towards sweeper cover
palmed over the bar! Slot ball on leg. Gill gets down on one knee and hacks it flat to Hetmyer at deep mid wicket, who pushes it over the fence. Hetmyer will be disappointed with that!
this is a Gill special! Pushed in full on middle and off. Gill dances down, creates room and carves it over extra cover!
this is speared in a little more and Buttler jams it out into the off side
Buttler goes after Jadeja straightaway! A little floaty and a touch too full outside off. Buttler goes through the line and lifts it over extra cover!
googly on a length on off. Buttler reads it off the pitch and prods it into the vacant short mid wicket region to get off the mark

clothed to long on, and Punja breaks through! Googly floated up full outside off, and Sudharsan is enticed into the big hit. The bat, though, closes upon impact and the ball arrows off the lower part of the blade. Archer tracks it and the takes it. Sudharsan livid with himself, but RR have something to show for this middle overs squeeze!
googly hung up on a length wide outside off. Sudharsan looks for the reverse but only swishes at thin air
back of a length on middle and leg. Gill turns it towards deep mid wicket and brings up his fourth half-century of the season!
googly on a back of a length outside off. Sudharsan hangs back and jabs it towards sweeper cover
googly on a back of a length on leg. Sudharsan hacks at it and chunks it off the inside edge towards deep backward square leg
fired in full and wide. Gill tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it back to the bowler
on a length outside off, bowled from over the wicket. Sudharsan opens his bat face and dabs it towards short third
low full toss on middle and leg. Gill knocks it to long on
shortish again, and with more width on offer. Gill cuts it behind point and hobbles through for a couple of runs. Gill not looking very comfortable here
shortish just outside off. Sudharsan opens up his stance and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Gill gets on top of the bounce and punches it towards deep point

a direct hit, and Gill might have been short! Back of a length, tucking up the batter on middle and leg as he advances. Gill pushes it to extra cover and sets off. Might have been in trouble had Jaiswal hit his mark
back of a length on middle and leg. Gill bunts it into the mid wicket region and calls two. Has to scramble a little but makes it back
fifty up for Sudharsan! Shortish again, outside off. Sudharsan hangs back on the googly and jabs it out to sweeper cover
flighted up full on middle and off. Gill gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to long off
googly on a length outside off. Sudharsan waits for it before punching it towards sweeper cpver
deft touch! Googly on a back of a length outside off. Sudharsan goes back and across and with a deft dab, beats short third to his right!
and that is how it stays. First boundary-less over this innings. Back of a length on the stumps and Sudharsan eases it out to long off
back of a length outside off. Gill hangs back before jabbing it towards sweeper cover
length ball on middle and off. Sudharsan waits for it before turning it towards deep backward square leg
fired in on a length on the stumps. Sudharsan dinks it into the square leg region and hurtles back for a couple of runs

almost a world-class grab! Given a bit of air on a fullish length outside off. Gill chips it towards extra cover, where Jaiswal flies one-handed to his right but cannot make it stick. Very tough chance!
darted in on a length on middle and off. Gill prods it back to the bowler
googly dragged down on off. Skids through a touch too and Gill cloths his pull towards deep mid wicket
short and wide outside off. Gill lets it go and sees the umpire stretch out his arms. More extras
just over! Fired in on a length down leg. Gill brings out the sweep and even though he top-edges it, he gets enough on it to clear short fine!
googly on a back of a length outside off. Sudharsan goes back and jabs it towards sweeper cover
low full toss outside off. Gill stretches forward and drives it to long off
shortish just outside off. Sudharsan sets up for the pull but swings too early. Jurel fumbles and ends up conceding a bye
short and wide outside off. Gill hops back and cuts it towards deep point
angled in full on middle and leg. Gill knocks it to long on and keeps strike
this just keeps getting better! Half-volley outside off and Gill climbs into it. He steps forward and creams it past mid off!
very full just outside off. Sudharsan opens his bat face and dabs it towards backward point
through the gap again! Low full toss but the width is the problem again. Sudharsan frees his arms and cracks it through cover!
slower ball on a full length on middle and leg. Eased down the ground to long on
no immediate change in fortunes, though! Zipped into the blockhole on middle and leg. Gill gives himself room and jams down on it. Squirts it off the toe-end and gets it to the keeper's right!
back of a length outside off. Gill hangs back and guides it towards deep backward point
fetch that too, and Gill is taking Archer down! Over-pitched just outside off and in the arc. Gill goes through the line and pumps it over the bowler's head!
back of a length on off. Gill gets behind the line of the ball and defends
play that on repeat! This is a serious shot. Full outside off. Gill plants his front foot, shows the maker's name and creams it over mid off!
length just outside off and this skips through. Gill has a wild mow across the line and only connects with the fresh Jaipur air
another top shot! Shortish outside off. Gill gets up on his toes, gets his hands through the ball and threads it between point and cover!
this is, well, ordinary bowling! Slow, short and down leg. Sudharsan has breakfast, lunch, a bit of an evening tea and helps it over short fine leg!
short and smashed! Banged in on middle and leg, and this sits up. Sudharsan picks it up nicely and dumps it over the deep square leg fence!
another attempted yorker on middle and off. Sudharsan jams down on it and digs it out towards mid wicket

big lbw shout, not given! Searing yorker on leg, and this causes the batter all sorts of problems. Sudharsan plays around it and Deshpande pleads and pleads, only to be turned down by the umpire. Jaiswal, though, thinks this is worth a review and goes upstairs. No bat involved, but did this pitch in line? Well, it did not. Pitching just outside leg, and Sudharsan stays!
low full toss outside off. Gill comes forward and pushes it enough to mid off's left for a single
scorched across the turf! Hard length on middle and off. Gill marches down, creates room and knifes it past backward point!
back of a length on the pads. Sudharsan lets the ball come to him before patting it gently into the on side
right in the slot, and this has been sent soaring over long on! Slower ball too and Sudharsan picks it early. Plants his front foot and unleashes a whip well over the fence!
length ball outside off. Sudharsan gets on top of the bounce and drives it on the up towards extra cover
loose ball and punished! Length ball well down leg. Sudharsan lets the ball come to him before glancing it uppishly past short fine leg!
length ball on middle and off. Sudharsan gets a half stride in before punching it back to the bowler
short and drifting down leg. Sudharsan swings and misses, and the umpire has to stretch out his arms again
fullish on middle and leg, bowled from around the wicket. Sudharsan presses half forward and turns it towards mid wicket
fullish just outside off. Sudharsan has a jab at it and chunks it off the inside edge behind square
zipped in fuller on middle and off. Sudharsan comes forward and pokes it to mid on
shot! A touch too short, and a touch too wide. Sudharsan latches onto it by standing up on his toes and razing it through cover point!
shortish and sliding down leg. Sudharsan has a swipe at it and misses. Called a wide, though
into the blockhole outside off, shaping away a touch. Gill clinks it to mid off and saunters across to the other end
back of a length just outside off. Sudharsan opens his bat face late and runs it down to deep third
back of a length on middle and leg, and this curves back in. Bowled at 143.1kph and this rushes the batter, with Sudharsan getting pinged on the pad
back of a length outside off. Sudharsan stands tall on the front foot and jabs it straight to extra cover. There is an errant throw involved too, and Sudharsan keeps strike courtesy and overthrow
just over! Full and angling into the pads from around the wicket. Sudharsan closes his bat face too early and pops it just beyond extra cover off the leading edge
full and swinging into the pads. Gill tucks it neatly towards deep backward square leg and opens his account
Archer finally finds his mark. Nails the yorker excellently outside off and Gill is too late to bring his bat down. Squirms past the toe-end of his blade
and it is a hat-trick of wides now. Goes for the leg-stump yorker. Strays in line and some more arm exercise for the umpire
and Archer fires in another wide. Radar not quite right so far. Well down leg again and an easy decision for the umpire once Gill misses his flick
oh dear! Full and speared down leg. Gill does not make contact and the ball keeps swinging away from Jurel. Five bonus runs, and the Free hit continues!

back of a length outside off. Sudharsan waits for it and dabs it towards backward point, who misfields and ends up conceding a run. But hang on - RR's troubles do not end there, because Archer has overstepped, and by a fair margin too!
back of a length just outside off. Sudharsan gets up on his toes and defends
back of a length outside off and this nips away. A bit of extra lift too and Sudharsan wafts at fresh air. Called a wide, much to the bowler's annoyance
short, wide and thumped! Banged in outside off and this sits up a little. Sudharsan leaps up onto his toes and slams it over point!

another terrible shank, and Holder finishes off the demolition job! GT go level with SRH at the top of the table, and RR have been consigned to another mid-season defeat! Half-way down outside off and this climbs steeply too. Deshpande cannot control his swat and only clinks it towards backward point. A tame end to what was largely a tame RR performance, and GT have been full value for the two points tonight!
slanted in full on the stumps. Brijesh does not move his feet and prods it to point. Gets called through for a single, and he would have been a mile short had there been a direct hit

skied, and Holder has another! Short ball outside off and Holder generates steep bounce with this. Shanaka looks to flat-bat it but gets it all wrong. Skews it up and Gill, stationed at mid off, completes the most regulation of catches. GT almost there now!
very full outside off. Shanaka tips it to extra cover and keeps strike
Siraj tests out the middle of the track again. A little outside off and Shanaka misses with his attempted upper-cut
banged in short and this angles into the batter. Shanaka swings and misses, and the umpire calls it a wide on height
over the top! Slot ball on off. Shanaka gives himself enough swinging room and pops it over mid off. Clean strike!
back of a length on off. Shanaka backs away again before cracking it towards swweper cover. Top effort by Rabada to his right to save two
back of a length on middle and leg. Deshpande stands up tall and hacks it to long on
back of a length on off. Shanaka gives himself room and powers it past extra cover
back of a length on middle and leg. Deshpande gets behind the line of the ball and defends

well, Holder has a wicket now! And it is a short ball that does the trick. Archer swings like a rusty gate again and is too late on the stroke. The ball kisses the top edge and Buttler completes the most regulation of catches. RR eight down now!

chaos in Jaipur! Banged in short on off. Archer swipes and misses, and the ball rolls off his body into the on side. Shanaka hares down for the run, only to be sent back. Holder tries to hit the stumps and misses. Rashid, trying to get to the stumps, cannot do much with the throw either
into the blockhole, slanting into the toes. Archer swings for the fences and misses. Lucky to see his leg stump still intact
shortish outside off. Archer hangs back and scuffs it towards extra cover
Archer gets his first boundary! Full and straying onto the pads. Archer uses the pace and tickles it past short fine leg!
dragged down outside off. Archer goes back and knocks it to long on

Rashid off on a celebrappeal, and the finger goes up! Jadeja, though, wants to review! Another fizzing delivery, pitching full on leg and then straightening a touch. Jadeja plays outside the line and gets beaten on the inside. Impact is on the front pad, and this could be a review more in hope. No bat involved. And Ball Tracking has the crashing into middle and leg. Jadeja has to go, and he takes a review along with him too!
beyond the fence, just! Slower, fuller and in the slot outside leg. Jadeja gets down on one knee and swipes it over deep backward square leg!
back of a length on middle and off. Spins back in sharply and raps Jadeja on the body. He was perhaps looking to sweep but was in no position to do so
back of a length on middle and off. Shanaka turns it towards deep mid wicket. Calls for two initially but abandons that idea mid-way
fizzed in full just outside leg. Jadeja plays all around it and the ball rolls off the pad behind square
low full toss, angling into leg stump. Shanaka shanks it off the inside edge into his pad, with the ball rolling towards the keeper
very full outside off. Jadeja shapes up for the sweep initially before changing his mind. Dabs it down to deep third in the end
back of a length just outside off. Shanaka waits for it before stabbing it towards deep mid wicket
slower bumper just outside off. Jadeja gets on top of the bounce and hacks it to deep mid wicket
hard length on middle and leg. Jadeja gets up on his toes and dinks it inot the square leg region for an easy brace
length just outside off. Jadeja has a waft at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat behind square
some power on that! On a length outside off. Shanaka gets down on one knee and blisters it past mid wicket. Sundar got a hand to it but it was too hot to handle!
shortish on the pads. Shanaka lets hte ball arrive before nudging it behind square. Off the mark with a couple of runs

off stump knocked back, and Rashid has the last laugh! This is beautiful bowling. Fullish on leg and with just enough air to tempt Dubey into a slog. He does so but loses all his shape. Loses track of the ball too and he hears the rattling of his stumps soon after. RR on the ropes!
Dubey launches one into the stands! A little floaty and in the arc just outside off. Dubey gets his front foot out of the way and smokes it over wide long on!
back of a length on the pads. Dubey helps it behind square and dashes back for a couple of runs
back of a length on off. Spins back in and Dubey, cramped for room, dabs it towards backward point
nicely done! Back of a length outside off. Jadeja gets down on one knee early and pummels it between deep mid wicket and deep backward square leg!
how has that missed?! Zinged in on a back of a length on leg. Jadeja backs away and looks for the cut. Misses it and the ball shaves leg stump!
back of a length on middle and off. Dubey hangs back and punches it to long off
pushed in full on middle and off. Dubey plays it back to the bowler
darted in full just outside off. Jadeja comes forward and knocks it to long on
back of a length on middle and leg. Jadeja places it perfectly between deep mid wicket and deep square, and tears back for two
googly on a back of a length outside off. Dubey stays back and prods it into the off side
back of a length on the pads. Jadeja helps it past short fine leg and picks up a single

big, big lbw shout, and this looks very close. Given not out, but GT review! Another ripping leg-break, pitching on a fullish length on off and spinning in. Jadeja defends with bat and pad close together, and this may just have grazed the pad first. The bat has clearly struck the front pad first, and Jadeja could be in trouble here. Ball Tracking comes up now and...it reckons the ball would have clipped the outside of off stump. Umpire's Call, and Jadeja stays!
back of a length on middle and leg. Dubey goes back and works it towards deep backward square leg
fullish on the stumps. Dubey comes forward and defends
sloppy on the fence! Zipped in full on the pads. Dubey uses the pace and glances it fine. Sai Kishore makes up the ground but then lets the ball slip through his fingers and into the fence!
back of a length outside off. Dubey drives it on the up to long off and retains strike
shortish again, outside off. Dubey goes back and cuts it towards backward point
fullish and hung up outside off. Dubey has a prod at it and skews it off the outside edge towards short third
shortish, finishing on off. Jadeja gives himself room and cuts it towards sweeper cover
back of a length just outside off. Jadeja hangs back and jabs it towards extra cover
angled in full on the stumps, from around the wicket. Jadeja defends
fullish just outside off. Dubey lunges forward and smothers it

does him all ends up, and Rashid has the ball on a string! Another fizzing leg-break, on a fullish length on middle and off. Drifts in a little and then rips away. Ferreira has no clue about it and he plays for the googly. Plays down the wrong line, and Ferreira has to trudge off. Rashid is over the moon, and GT firmly in control now!
buffet ball, and Ferreira feasts to begin his innings! Dragged down on off. Ferreira rocks back and hammers it past mid wicket!

hot knife through butter, and Jurel is outta here! Fizzed through on a length just outside off. Jurel plays the flatter trajectory and shapes for the cut. Gives himself room but is awfully late on the stroke. The ball whizzes past his flailing blade and knocks back off stump. Rashid on the board early!
back of a length on middle and off. Jadeja goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket
fullish on off. Jadeja goes searching for it and manages a scratch before the ball pings off his front pad into the off side
low full toss on middle and off. Jadeja flicks it out to deep mid wicket
shot! Shortish outside off and Jadeja uses the angle from around the wicket to his advantage. He rocks back and crashes it behind point!
back of a length outside off. Jadeja has a waft at it and chops it towards short third
shortish on off. Jurel gives himself room and cuts it towards deep point
back of a length on middle and leg. Jadeja tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on middle and leg. Skids through and Jurel stabs it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
four more - Jadeja is here to play! Full and speared into the pads. Jadeja snaps his wrists into action and muscles it over mid wicket!
oh, hello! Oh, hello! Right in the slot on middle and leg, and Jadeja says thank you very much. He clears his front leg and smears it over deep square leg!

another high ball, and Holder is not going to drop that! Rabada at it again. Hard length just outside off and this gets a touch big on Hetmyer, as he looks to swipe at it. Seems like a cutter too and that messes up Hetmyer's timing. A feeble shank and Holder does the rest at mid on!
angled across on a length outside off. Hetmyer looks to go inside-out and slices it over cover point
back of a length just outside off. Hetmyer hacks it to mid wicket. Jurel sets off for the run, only to be sent back. A direct hit might have had him in trouble
Hetmyer finds the fence too! Low full toss on the pads. Hetmyer brings his wrists into play and clips it over mid wicket!
dumped into the stands again! Shortish on middle and leg. Jurel spots the length early and mows it over deep mid wicket!
another short ball, angling into middle and leg. Jurel gets inside the line and helps it straight to short fine leg
right out of the screws! Dug in outside off but this sits up nicely. Jurel rocks back and wallops it flat over deep square leg!
angled in on a length just outside off. Jurel presses half forward and punches it to mid on
cleverly done! Back of a length outside off. Jurel gets up on his toes and guides it neatly past short third!
Jurel with a maximum now! Right in the slot outside off. Jurel plants his front foot and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
back of a length on middle and leg. Hetmyer hops up onto his toes and pats it towards mid wicket
fullish outside off. Hetmyer gets a better stride in and pushes it towards cover point
back of a length on off. Hetmyer gets a half stride in and defends

goes straight up, and Rabada sends back the other RR opener too! Banged in short just outside off and this climbs through too. Bowled at 152.1kph and Jaiswal is rushed all ends up on the pull. Splices it terribly and Sindhu, running in from extra cover, hands Rabada his first wicket. Rabada is pumped; RR, under pressure!
banged in short, just outside off. Jaiswal swipes across the line and muscles it over mid wicket

massive mix-up but no damage done! Length just outside off. Jaiswal punches it towards extra cover and sets off. Almost has a mid-pitch conversation with his partner but there is a misfield in the ring, which allows both batters to make it back
full outside off. Jurel gets onto the front foot and drives it to mid off

sharp short ball, and Sooryavanshi perishes! This is a brutish delivery, bowled at 146.6kph and climbing through on middle and leg. Sooryavanshi is cramped on the pull and cannot free his arms the way he would like. Only gets height, via the top edge and Arshad, running to his right from short fine, gobbles up the chance. Big, big moment in the game!
what timing! Full on the stumps and this travels too. Sooryavanshi whips through the ball and scorches it past mid off!
smart batting! Shortish just outside off. Sooryavanshi knows deep third has come up so he holds his stroke and glides it between short third and backward point!
back of a length just outside off. Sooryavanshi rises with the bounce and pokes it towards point
pick that one out too! Back of a length and too much width on offer. Sooryavanshi extends his arms and blasts it over cover!
edged but safe! Back of a length outside off. Sooryavanshi goes chasing after this too and gets a thick outside edge that flies down to deep third
hard length on middle and off. Gets a little big on Sooryavanshi and he splices it into the point region
back of a length outside off and this skips through. Sooryavanshi continues swinging for the hills but this time, he misses
